title: Library
sub: Everything nexcrate manages. A title can have several versions, like Full HD and 4K.
empty: Nothing found. Check the search and the filters.

emptyLibrary.title: No movies yet
emptyLibrary.freshText: Search for a movie and pick its versions. nexcrate only starts searching for downloads in a later step.
emptyLibrary.importText: If you already use Radarr, nexcrate fetches your movies from there. Nothing changes in Radarr.
emptyLibrary.diskText: If your movies already lie in folders, nexcrate reads them. You confirm which movie is which.

add.title: Add a movie
add.idle: Type the title of a movie. nexcrate looks it up on TMDB.
add.noResults: No results. Try another word or leave out the year.
add.more: {{shown}} of {{total}} results. Adding the year narrows it down.
add.pickVersionsHint: You can add more versions later on the title's page.
add.noVersions: There is no movie version yet. Create one first, for example Full HD.
add.allExist: {{title}} already has every movie version there is. You create more versions in Settings.
add.searchLater: nexcrate only starts searching for downloads in a later step. Until then the version shows as wanted in the library.
add.menuLabel: Add: search for a movie or read folders
add.onDiskSeries_one: Already on disk: {{folder}} with one file; nexcrate reads it before it searches.
add.onDiskSeries_other: Already on disk: {{folder}} with {{value}} files; nexcrate reads them before it searches.

select.ruleHint: The rule applies to every version of the selected series and overwrites switches set by hand.
select.ruleDone_one: {{value}} series version follows the rule now.
select.ruleDone_other: {{value}} series versions follow the rule now.
select.artistsLeft_one: {{value}} artist gets no new albums any more.
select.artistsLeft_other: {{value}} artists get no new albums any more.

seriesType.hint: Series a Sonarr connection feeds are left out: Sonarr decides their kind.
seriesType.fed_one: {{value}} series was left out, its Sonarr decides its kind.
seriesType.fed_other: {{value}} series were left out, their Sonarr decides their kind.

remove.intro: The titles leave nexcrate, and their running downloads are cancelled. Titles a Radarr, Sonarr or Lidarr connection still feeds stay with its versions.
remove.files: Move the files into the recycle bin
remove.filesHint: The files of the titles go into the recycle bin first and can be brought back from there for the set time. Without it they stay where they are.
remove.doneFiles_one: {{value}} file is in the recycle bin.
remove.doneFiles_other: {{value}} files are in the recycle bin.
remove.doneFed_one: {{value}} title stays because a connection feeds it.
remove.doneFed_other: {{value}} titles stay because a connection feeds them.

open.missing: This target does not exist in nexcrate, or not any more.

typeProposals.title: Check the type of the series
typeProposals.hint: TMDB suggests a type for every series: anime (the keyword anime, or animation in Japanese), daily (news and talk shows) or standard. These are the series where that differs from their type. Only what you tick is taken; series a Sonarr connection fills are left out, Sonarr decides there.
typeProposals.problem: TMDB could not be reached, or no TMDB key is stored. The list shows what is known so far.
typeProposals.none: No series differs from TMDB's proposal.
typeProposals.done_one: {{value}} series now has the proposed type.
typeProposals.done_other: {{value}} series now have the proposed type.
